Plot results using UpSet plot

Source: R/plot_methods.R
intersection_plt.Rd

Plot results using UpSet plot

Usage

intersection_plt(
  rec,
  steps = steps_ids(rec, "da"),
  ordered_by = c("freq", "degree"),
  font_size = 2,
  target = NULL,
  contrast_id = NULL
)

Arguments

rec

A prepped Recipe object.

steps

Character vector with step_ids to take in account.

ordered_by

How the intersections in the matrix should be ordered by. Options include frequency (entered as "freq"), degree, or both in any order.

font_size

Size of the font.

target

Optional modeled target to include.

contrast_id

Optional modeled contrast identifier to include.

Value

UpSet plot, or invisible NULL with an informational message when no significant taxa are available for the selected hypotheses.

Examples

data(test_prep_rec)

if (requireNamespace("UpSetR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  ## UpSet plot of shared discoveries
  intersection_plt(test_prep_rec)

  ## Order intersections by the number of methods involved
  intersection_plt(test_prep_rec, ordered_by = "degree")
}
